# Menu Manager

Laravel Composer package for rendering configurable menus with Blade.

## Primary Docs

- README.md
- CHANGELOG.md
- MCP.md

## Source

- src/Services/MenuBuilder.php
- src/Providers/MenuManagerServiceProvider.php
- src/config/menu-manager.php
- src/resources/views/menu.blade.php
- src/resources/views/partials/items.blade.php
- src/resources/views/partials/attributes.blade.php

## Tests

- tests/MenuBuilderTest.php

## Commands

```bash
composer install
composer test
```
